visual_checks.evidence: All three diff×10 images (hero, side, top) show no horizontal or vertical lines at 32px or 16px spacing. The diff pattern is spatially irregular with no periodic structure.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: No 32×32 or 16×16 constant-color blocks appear in any rendered view where the reference has detail. All object regions show continuous textural variation matching the reference.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: No localized dark regions in the render where reference shows coverage. Hero view is generally darker than reference but uniformly so — not localized black holes. No bright concentrated spots in diff×10 indicating missing coverage >16px.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: No saturated R/G/B flat stripes in any rendered view. Hero view is underexposed relative to reference but shows no clipping artifacts or banded saturation.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: No structured ringing or halos visible at object silhouettes in any view. Edges in hero, side, and top renders are clean and consistent with the reference silhouette shape.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No correlated patches of pure black, white, or magenta in any rendered image. All pixel values appear to be valid floating-point results.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff×10 images do not show bright object-silhouette outlines that would indicate coordinate errors. The diff pattern is distributed as speckle over the object interior, not as a displaced-silhouette halo.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff×10 images are dominated by fine, spatially-uniform speckle noise on the object surface. No grids, banded gradients, edge outlines, or other structured patterns are present. This is consistent with bfloat16 quantization noise from the changed Q-summation path.

reasoning: Visual gate passes on all 8 checks: no tile seams, no uniform-fill blocks, no missing-splat holes, no clipping bands, no ringing, no NaN/Inf, no geometry shift, and diff×10 structure is uniform speckle consistent with bfloat16 quantization noise from the fused Q-summation change. However, two of three views fall below the 40 dB kernel-algebra PSNR floor: hero at 39.69 dB and top at 38.87 dB. Per spec, any view below the 40 dB floor for class kernel-algebra triggers NEEDS_REVIEW (not auto-REJECT since visuals are clean). Timing is essentially break-even: median 97.9 ms vs prev_best 97.77 ms (+0.13%), within the 1.02× tolerance. Per-view PSNR delta is only 4.20 dB (well under 20 dB threshold) and per-view ms ratio is 1.16× (well under 2×). The NEEDS_REVIEW verdict is driven solely by two views sub-floor — the iteration produces structurally clean output but the fused Q-summation path is introducing enough bfloat16 accumulation error to push hero and top below 40 dB, which warrants human review before promotion.
